notes.title: The future of the Mojo game series is in your hands.
Mojo 3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34107371/7290cba6df4ec779cad1d7c2aba3b27e31589fe3.png[/img]

The future of [i]Mojo 3[/i] (both the commercial game and the free promo version) is still uncertain. We have been clearly witnessing a substantially decreasing interest of the community towards the game since the second part was released.

[i]Mojo: Hanako[/i] and [i]Mojo 2: Mia[/i] have shown equal number of downloads but the figures of the latter has fallen:
[list]
[*] 50% fewer users have completed the game ([b]24.6 vs. 12.5[/b]);
[*] 40% fewer reviews have been added ([b]650 vs. 392[/b]).
[/list]

[i]Mojo XXX[/i] is a litmus test for us. The decision about [i]Mojo 3[/i] will be taken basing on the results of the game release.

The future of the Mojo game series is in your hands.
